name: poe2-endgame-companion
description: Path of Exile 2 character analysis and endgame companion. Merges POE2-MCP-V2 and Poe2-endgame.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @poe2/core && npm run build --workspace @poe2/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @poe2/core && npm run test --workspace @poe2/web
scripts.//typecheck: The core must be BUILT first: apps/web resolves @poe2/core to its dist/, so typechecking the web app before that exists fails with 40 cascading errors.
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @poe2/core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.//check:all: check plus the two suites CI runs outside the root test script: the hook/PR-body script tests and the separately installed ninja-proxy.
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run pob2:verify && npm run decode:reference -- --check && npm run test:scripts && npm --prefix services/ninja-proxy test
scripts.//pob2:oracle: Needs LuaJIT (scripts/pob2/install-luajit.sh) or Docker, and a built @poe2/core. --check fails on diff (CI job pob2-oracle).
